entries.author: jonahss
entries.current_title: Show HN: Trading cards made with e-ink displays
entries.excerpt: I made a thing! In 2014, I was holding a stack of iPhones and thought to myself: "Hey, if I had each phone display a playing card, I could click a button and they'd shuffle themselves" I pared that idea all the way down to this: trading cards made of e-ink displays. Right now, each card costs me about $20 each, but with only a bit more scale, I think I can get that down to $10. In doing this project, I learned how to design electronics and circuit boards. entries.title: Show HN: I built my own PM tool after trying Trello, Asana, ClickUp, etc.
entries.author: tonypham
entries.current_title: Show HN: I built my own PM tool after trying Trello, Asana, ClickUp, etc.
entries.excerpt: Hey HN, Over the past two years, I've been building Upbase, an all-in-one PM tool. I've tried so many project management tools over the years (Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Teamwork, Wrike, Monday, etc.) but they've all fallen short. Most of them are overly complicated and painful to use. Some others, like Trello, are too limited for my needs. Most importantly, most of these tools tend to be focused on team collaboration and completely ignore personal productivity. They are useful
entries.guide_zh: 试用多种项目管理工具后，作者自制 Upbase，追求完整而不过度复杂。

entries.title: Show HN: Haxophone
entries.author: javier_cardona
entries.excerpt: I built this during Covid. When I released it, some of the parts went out of stock or skyrocketed in price, no longer making this an economic DIY project. Now that things are getting back to almost normal, I thought I'd share it here and request feedback. This is a very niche project for people who like the same things I do: saxophones, Rust, mechanical keyboards and the Raspberry Pi.
entries.guide_zh: Haxophone 把萨克斯、Rust、机械键盘与树莓派结合成自制项目。
